title: link_loss_after_s
description: Setting: seconds without contact with Core before the Asset's link_loss failsafe triggers, timed on the Asset's own clock. Contact is any new (non-duplicate) message after the accepted hello that names this Asset in asset_id and was not sent by this Asset. Core sends admin.alive when it has sent nothing new for a third of this, and so does the Asset. Core counts the Asset offline after this long with nothing new from it. 30 unless set. Fractions allowed.
